# Open Mermaid

> Open Mermaid is a standalone, local-first browser workspace for creating, validating, organizing, sharing, and exporting Mermaid diagrams. It requires no account, application backend, API key, network analytics service, OpenAI or ChatGPT connection, or runtime CDN.

This file is a supplemental machine-readable index. It does not replace semantic HTML, canonical metadata, robots policy, or a sitemap, and its presence makes no ranking promise.

## Product

- [Open Mermaid home](/): Product summary, privacy promise, and independence contract.
- [Performance and Web Vitals](/performance/): Local-only diagnostics and the lab/field measurement model.
- [Editor](/editor/): Local multi-document Mermaid editor and sandboxed live preview.
- [About](/about/): Scope, principles, deferred features, and non-affiliation notice.
- [Privacy](/privacy/): Local storage, fragment sharing, export, and network-request disclosure.
- [Security](/security/): Renderer isolation, sanitization, bounded work, and reporting guidance.

## Important constraints

- Diagram content stays on the device unless the user explicitly shares, copies, imports, or exports it.
- Fragment links are compressed but not encrypted.
- The standalone application is independent of ChatGPT, MCP, OpenAI, and AI-provider APIs.
- Open Mermaid does not claim arbitrary user-authored diagrams are automatically accessible.
- Upstream beta and experimental Mermaid grammars are labeled and can change between pinned versions.
- Open Mermaid is independent and is not affiliated with the Mermaid project or OpenAI.
